description: This Perl script is used for extracting and parsing target, architecture, kernel, and device information by invoking make commands in a build environment. It processes build configuration data related to specific hardware targets and generates formatted output based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information by running a make command in a given target directory, extracting details like target name, architecture, kernel version, and features, and storing them in global hashes.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profile information from make command output for a specific target directory and subtarget, managing alternative device names, and storing data in a global hash.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target makefiles, gathers subtarget info, and calls parse_targetinfo for each subtarget.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specific target/subtarget by invoking parse_devices.
